posts.cooked:
So to be clear:

Vital Strenght of earth has a sacred site in a land, give 3 defensive. In that same land there is 2 dahan and 6 point of invader.

Ravage happens 

Invader deal 6 damage to the Dahan, 3 of which is defended and 2 damage kills of a Dahan and adding 1 damage to the other Dahan.

Invader deal 6 damage to the land, 3 of which is defended and dealing 3 dmage to the land adding a blight (Only need 2 damage to add a blight). Removing Vital's Presence, removing his sacred site but that does not affect  the current turn.

The remaning Dahan attack and deal 2 damage to invaders, even though it is tipped over..

 

Am I correct with this logic or have i been playing wrong.

 

Edit: changed damage to 6 to Demonstrate another rule.

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked:
speedyolrac:

So to be clear:Vital Strenght of earth has a sacred site in a land, give 3 defensive. In that same land there is 2 dahan and 5 point of invader.Ravage happens Invader deal 5 damage to the Dahan, 3 of which is defended and kills of a Dahan.Invader deal 5 damage to the land, 3 of which is defended and adds a blgiht. Removing Vital's Presence, removing his sacred site but that does not affect  the current turn.The remading Dahan attack and deal 2 damage. Am I correct with this logic or have i been playing wrong.

3 damage has to be done to the land to cause a blight.   So you would still keep your sacred site.   You would need six points of invaders to have the invaders blight the land in that case.   A Dahan would still be destroyed in your example though.
